item.description:
Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium
URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs

Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you.

Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough.

Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly.

Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product.

As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product.

  • You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions.
  • With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results.
  • You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries.

Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build.

What are we looking for in you?

  • You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work.
  • Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn. You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks.
  • You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning. You think along, question things and keep building new solutions.
  • You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset.
  • You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test.
  • You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework. Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus.
  • You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies.
  • You have a very good command of English, for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset.
  • You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET, so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration.
  • You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central.

Twikey offers you:

  • An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first.
  • The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room.
  • An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel!
  • A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere.
  • A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise, shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine.
  • Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed!
  • A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower.
  • A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose.
  • The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast!

A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

item.title: Proxify AB: Senior Backend Developer (Node.js / Nest.js)
item.description:
Headquarters: Sweden
URL: http://career.proxify.io

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior Backend (Node.js / Nest.js) Developer to join our fast-growing network. You’ll be responsible for building modern and scalable web applications, working closely with backend developers and designers to create intuitive user experiences.

This is a long-term, full-time remote role with opportunities to work on innovative projects that make a difference.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years with Node.js and 3+ past years with Nest.js
  • Strong expertise in Node.js and Nest.js frameworks.
  • Proven experience building REST and/or GraphQL APIs.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Solid experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth2).
  • Experience with unit/integration testing (e.g., Jest, Mocha).
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.
  • Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

 

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture and message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Experience with Docker and containerized applications.
  • Knowledge of microservices and serverless architectures.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop robust, scalable, and secure backend applications using Node.js and Nest.js.
  • Implement RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints, and microservices architectures.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Integrate with databases (SQL/NoSQL) and external services via APIs.
  • Ensure code quality, security, and compliance with industry standards.

item.title: Reddit: Backend Engineer, IAM
item.description:
Headquarters: Remote - United States

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

This is a remote-friendly role. Reddit has a flexible first workforce.

The Identity and Access Management team develops and maintains a set of mission critical, highly performant, and highly scalable systems that manage user identity, authentication, and authorization for all of our millions of daily users and backend services.

Some of our present and future challenges include:

  • Building systems around consumer IAM to meet the needs of Reddit’s engineering organization and millions of daily users.
  • Design, build and ship backend services powering experiences for one of the most visited sites in the world.
  • Work with product management, security, client engineering, and backend teams to define and implement Reddit’s IAM vision and roadmap.

In your day-to-day, you will:

  • Steer: Work with the team to select, scope, and execute on high leverage projects that align with Reddit’s goals.
  • Build: Execute on a strategy and create a more performant, more scalable, higher quality architecture around IAM.
  • XFN Collaboration: Work together with a variety of cross functional teams across Reddit Engineering.
  • Evolve: Learn and improve your own technical and non-technical abilities.

Who you might be:

  • 3+ years of experience designing and developing distributed backend systems 
  • IAM backend experience in either authorization or authentication domain
  • Proficiency in one or more general purpose programming languages (preferably Go).
  • Capability with essential cloud infrastructure (Kubernetes, CI/CD, AWS, GCP).
  • High empathy and excellent communication skills to collaborate across the organization.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave 

 

 

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:
$164,200—$229,900 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.
